title: Three Weeks and One Short Stick
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：leg　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 leg 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the doctor ① supported the leg that no patient in the clinic would have recorded, and he said the supporting was the whole of the week. The ② leg, meaning the limb itself and not the stick, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a leg, he said, is the only thing in a clinic that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ leg in that clinic had the same short stick beside it, and the ④ leg at the far bed, meaning the step they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A leg, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the doctor said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the leg was the whole of the matter, meaning the strength and not the limb. The ⑥ leg, meaning the strength and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; leg, he said, is either something you support or the only word that means both a limb and a strength. He said the strength is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ leg had become a line in a card, and the card had become an argument about the short stick. The ⑧ leg of the whole thing, the doctor wrote in July, was one clinic and three weeks of recording; leg, he said, is either the step at the far bed or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ leg I remember is the limb recorded in the card, which closed in 1976 and is still recorded as the quietest in the clinic. A ⑩ leg, my mother said in 1978, is the only limb that improves by being recorded; every leg, she said, is a strength that has agreed to look like a limb. She said the strength was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 腿；下肢（指诊室里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 腿；下肢（指那条腿本身，与拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：support the leg 托住这条腿
D. n. 腿；下肢（指留给孩子们数的那一步那一条）
E. n. 疗伤之事（抽象总称，指一处诊室的腿之事）
F. n. 腿；下肢（指病历里写到、被记载的的那一条）
G. n. 力气、支撑（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 支撑（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: supported the leg that no patient in the clinic would have recorded
The leg, meaning the limb itself and not the stick
the leg at the far bed
the leg was the whole of the matter

The leg of the whole thing

answers.why: support the leg 意为“托住这条腿”，1969 年那位大夫把诊室里没有一位病人肯记载的一条腿做了一遍。
leg 意为“腿；下肢”，指那条腿本身而不是拐杖，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
leg 意为“腿；下肢”，指诊室里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
leg 意为“腿；下肢”，指最远那张床边留给孩子们数的那一步那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
leg 意为“力气、支撑”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份力气就是那件事的全部。
leg 意为“支撑”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条腿，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
leg 意为“腿；下肢”，指病历里写到、被记载的的那一条，到 1974 年这一条成了病历里的一行。
leg 意为“疗伤之事”，大夫七月写道，整件事的腿之事是一处诊室和三个星期的记载。
leg 意为“腿；下肢”，我记得的是病历里记载过的那一条，1976 年养好了，至今仍被说成诊室里最安静的一条。
leg 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，腿是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的腿。

那条腿，指的是那条腿本身而不是拐杖，经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。（leg）
